title: Falcon 9 Booster B1067 Sets New Reuse Record With 36th Flight
detail: Booster B1067 — SpaceX's most-flown Falcon 9 first stage — launched on a record-breaking 36th flight on July 9, 2026 at 5:25 a.m. EDT, carrying the 29-satellite Starlink 10-42 mission from Space Launch Complex 40, Cape Canaveral. The booster, which first flew in June 2021 and has previously supported NASA's Crew-3 and Crew-4 missions plus 24 Starlink batches, landed on the drone ship 'A Shortfall of Gravitas' about 8 minutes after liftoff — the vessel's 160th landing and SpaceX's 635th booster recovery overall, making B1067 the first orbital booster in history to reach 36 flights.

media.caption: A Falcon 9 rocket soars near the Moon during the Starlink 10-42 mission, July 9, 2026
